```{r}
source("analysis/scripts/spray_infection.R")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
raw_dir <- here("raw")
raw_file <- "spray_infections.xlsx"

my_order <- c(
  "Guy11",
  "Δmst7",
  "MST7-GFP 9.2",
  "MST7-GFP 12.2",
  "MST7S358D-GFP 1.1",
  "MST7S358D-GFP 3.1",
  "MST7S358A-GFP 1.3",
  "MST7S358A-GFP 3.5"
)

my_reps <- c(1,2,4,5)   # for example, only biorep 1 and 3

plot_genotype_boxplot(
    file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
    genotype_order = my_order,
    reps = my_reps)
```

## One-way ANOVA

```{r}
# Perform one-way ANOVA
anova_result <- perform_anova(
    file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
    genotype_order = my_order,
    reps = my_reps)
anova_summary <- summary(anova_result)
print(anova_summary)

# Extract p-value from ANOVA
anova_pvalue <- anova_summary[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]
anova_fstat <- anova_summary[[1]]$`F value`[1]
```

## Tukey Post-hoc Test

```{r}
# Perform Tukey HSD test
tukey_result <- perform_tukey(
    file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
    genotype_order = my_order,
    reps = my_reps)
print(tukey_result)
```

## Figure with Tukey Test Results

```{r}
# Create figure with significance bars and stars
fig_tukey <- plot_with_tukey_annotations(
    file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
    genotype_order = my_order,
    reps = my_reps)

print(fig_tukey)
```

## Save Figure with ggsave

```{r}
# Save the Tukey test figure
ggsave(
  filename = here("figures/virulence_tukey_test_results.png"),
  plot = fig_tukey,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```
